DONE

Not fully complete: `gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties` was blocked as a sensitive file, so the Gradle wrapper is missing. The README explains how to generate it. The project has not been compiled.

- **Baseline profile module:** the CLAUDE.md rule requires a `baselineprofile` module, so I added one alongside `app`. It is test-only and contains no app code. This departs from your "single module" wording.
- **Dependencies:** all versions are in `gradle/libs.versions.toml`. Repositories are `google()` and `mavenCentral()` only.
- **Session:** tokens are encrypted with AES-256-GCM, with the key in the Android Keystore. Only the ciphertext is stored, in DataStore.
- **Refresh:** refreshes are serialised, since refresh tokens are single use.
